description: This file defines the implementation of the IFactories interface within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It manages a singleton instance of IFactories, providing methods to assign, access, and check availability of the instance.

classes.name: IFactories
classes.description: Interface for factory management within the plugin host, including static methods for singleton management.

methods.name: Assign
methods.description: Assigns a new instance of IFactories to the singleton, with assertions to ensure proper state.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton instance of IFactories, asserting that it has been initialized.

methods.name: IsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the singleton instance of IFactories is available (not null).
